chars.OUSSAMA: OUSSAMA: a Moroccan young man about 25, short black hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark grey jogger trousers and white sneakers
chars.NEIGHBOUR: NEIGHBOUR: a Moroccan woman about 35, wearing modest long-sleeved pastel pink satin pajamas with white piping and a white bath towel wrapped around her head, light makeup

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Upstairs landing of a Casablanca duplex house, tiled staircase. The NEIGHBOUR has just opened her apartment door, standing in the doorway in her pajamas and head towel, smiling politely. OUSSAMA stands on the landing facing her, eyes wide, surprised and awkward. Both fully visible in the centre of the frame, calm walls at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot on the same landing: OUSSAMA frozen, mouth slightly open, staring, comically forgetting what he came for. The NEIGHBOUR in the doorway adjusts the towel on her head, a few wet strands of hair. Warm hallway light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA on the landing puts his hand on his chest and bows his head slightly, thanking her shyly. The NEIGHBOUR in the doorway listens with a kind smile. Duplex staircase behind.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The NEIGHBOUR leans on the door frame with crossed arms, laughing playfully and teasing him, one eyebrow raised. OUSSAMA in front of her looks embarrassed, blushing. Doorway of a Moroccan apartment with a small plant.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA laughs nervously and scratches the back of his head, grinning. The NEIGHBOUR smiles at him from the doorway. Light comic mood, landing of a duplex house.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA alone on the staircase landing, glancing down the stairs toward his family's apartment door below, thoughtful and amazed, hand on the banister. Tiled Moroccan staircase, soft light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The NEIGHBOUR steps aside inside her doorway and waves him in with her hand, welcoming and friendly. Behind her a cosy Moroccan living room with a sedari sofa. OUSSAMA on the landing hesitates.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA stands at the threshold of the apartment, one foot inside, looking back over his shoulder down the stairs nervously. Inside the living room the NEIGHBOUR turns toward him with a mysterious smile, pointing to a room deeper in the apartment. Curious suspenseful mood.
